lines.text: Grade Comprehende reviews. An isolated producer follows the next skill. Deterministic checks score the result. One read-only rubric grader also scores unless --no-graders: it answers yes or no per expected.md item and checks each claim the review wrote against head. Grader verdicts do not change the exit code.
